property_summary: For any positive amount, after the owner calls withdrawAll on a funded contract, it is never the case that the call succeeds while the contract still retains exactly the full deposited amount (P either reverts or drains to zero); the mutant M always succeeds while retaining the full amount, so it violates the rule for every positive amount.
change_summary: Remove the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll transfers no funds.
